items.title: Bobby Hutcherson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: That’s George on there. Cedar Walton did all the arrangements.

ctx.x: Waiting. That’s George on there. Cedar Walton did all the arrangements.
You seem to have very special relationships with pianists and also great affinities with drummers. I’m looking at your discography, and I see that you recorded with Roy Haynes back in 1977.
